decisions.statement: The sampling is fixed here and recorded on the run row.
A call naming no description is refused.
The language is sent only to the backend that takes a language.
The model spoken through is settled by the backend named.
An answer that is no RIFF payload is a fault rather than a file written.
The audio is written where the caller named that audio and nowhere else.
Nothing here cuts the text into pieces.

definition: the command speaking text in a voice made up from a description of it
